'''Llohm Dunney''' was the [[Regent/Legends|Vice-Regent]] [[Accountant/Legends|Accountant]] for the [[Imperial Treasury]] who operated out of the [[City/Legends|city]]-[[Ecumenopolis/Legends|spanning]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Dunney was responsible for sending out [[e-mail]]s to [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] citizens who had outstanding debts to the Empire.

{{ExcerptIU|
IMMEDIATE ATTENTION REQUIRED.

This is an overdue fine notice from the Imperial Collection Agency. You have an outstanding fine debt with the Empire. You must attend to this responsibility immediately. Proceed directly to your nearest Imperial representative, hail them and pay your fine.

Valid representatives:

Stormtroopers
Imperial Officers
Other Members of the Imperial Military

Remember, the Empire relies upon the support of its citizens. We are fighting this rebellion for your safety and wellbeing. Please show proper respect for all Military and Police representatives of the Empire.

Vice-Regent Accountant
Llohm Dunney
Imperial Treasury, Coruscant
|attrib=E-mail from Vice-Regent Accountant Llohm Dunney
}}

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Llohm Dunney was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. Early in the game's lifespan, players could receive automated [[W:c:swg:Mail|e-mails]] regarding fines that have not yet been paid to the [[W:c:swg:Galactic Empire|Empire]]. Llohm Dunney's name could be seen by reading the message's signature.
